preconditions.description: The length of the string T is between 1 and 100000.
The number of tables N is between 1 and 600.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: The string T consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.
The output is less than or equal to the number of possible combinations of N bouquets from 26 kinds of flowers.
